AlphaMeaning.description: What the alpha channel of a texture holds.

oneOf.description: Nothing: the channel is fully opaque and is to be ignored.
Opacity.
Smoothness, as in the alpha channel of a `_ddna` normal map.

AlphaMode.description: How a material is blended with what is behind it, derived from its opacity and alpha test.

oneOf.description: Opaque.
Alpha tested: the surface is drawn where alpha reaches `alpha_test`.
Blended by opacity: `opacity` below 1, or a glass or decal shader.

Basis.description: The axes of every transform and of the GLB meshes.

oneOf.description: glTF's axes, Y up. A reader refuses a basis it does not know.

BuildInfo.description: The Build of the Archive a package was made from, as its build manifest states it.

public_patch.description: The public patch number, when the manifest has one.

CharacterSource.description: What a Character was made from.

body.description: The code of the body variant, e.g. `male`.

chf.description: The CHF file the head came from, as a file name without its folder; absent without a CHF.

loadout.description: The Loadout the pieces came from, as the user named it; absent without one.

name.description: The Character's name, also the name of its node.

ColourSpace.description: How the colour channels of a texture are encoded.

oneOf.description: sRGB transfer curve: colour data, such as a diffuse map.
Linear values: data such as normals, smoothness and metalness.

Coordinates.description: The coordinate system of a package.

basis.description:
The axes: always `gltf_y_up`, glTF's, as the GLB meshes have them. Node transforms are
already converted from the game's Z-up axes by the writer.

Element.description: An XML element of a material file the writer does not interpret.

attributes.description: The element's attributes in file order.

children.description: The element's children in file order.

EntityRef.description:
An Entity of the Archive. In `source.entity` of a Character package, which is made from no
Entity, `class_name` is the Character's name and `guid` is empty.

oneOf.description: A package of this tool.

Generator.description: The program that wrote a package.

Issue.description: Something that could not be resolved or written.

kind.description: A stable code of the kind, e.g. `geometry_missing` or `texture`.

name.description: The class name of the node's Entity, or the name of the material.

path.description: The port path of the node, or the texture file as the material file names it.

reason.description: The reason in words. Untrusted text from the Archive.

skipped.description: Whether the node is left out of the scene.

oneOf.description: Resolving the Assembly.
Loading or writing a texture.
Reading a material or a material layer.

Light.description:
A punctual light at a node of the kind `light`.

The node's transform is already turned so that the light shines along its local -Z axis, as
glTF and Blender lights do.

colour.description: The colour in linear red, green and blue, each in 0 to 1.

inner_cone.description:
The angle in radians from the axis where a spot light's falloff begins; present for the
kind `spot`.

intensity.description:
The intensity as the engine states it, not converted to a photometric unit; the engine's
unit is not documented, so the value is only good for comparing lights of one package.

outer_cone.description:
The angle in radians from the axis where a spot light ends, within 0 to a quarter turn;
present for the kind `spot`.

range.description:
The distance in metres beyond which the light has no effect; absent when the light has
none.

oneOf.description: Shines in all directions from the node.
Shines in a cone along the node's -Z axis.
Shines along the node's -Z axis from infinitely far away.

MaterialDescription.description:
A material as the game defines it: the inputs of a Blender or any other renderer's material.

Colours are linear and exactly those of the file; a palette is not applied. The
`parameters`, `attributes` and `elements` hold what the writer does not interpret, name and
value as the file has them.

alpha_mode.description: How the material is blended, derived from `opacity`, `alpha_test` and the shader.

alpha_test.description: The alpha-test threshold, 0 when the material is not alpha tested.

attributes.description: The attributes of the material element that no field above holds, in file order.

default_palette.description: The tint palette the library names as its default, a Record path.

elements.description:
The child elements of the material that are none of textures, layers, parameters or
sub-materials, as the file has them.

emissive.description: The emissive colour, linear; it counts times `glow`.

gen_mask.description:
The shader generation mask, split at `%`: `%NORMAL_MAP%SPECULAR_MAP` is `NORMAL_MAP` and
`SPECULAR_MAP`.

glow.description: The glow amount the emissive colour is multiplied by.

index.description:
The position of the material in the library's sub-material list, the material ID of the
submeshes; absent when the file is one material that serves every ID.

layer_shares.description:
The share of each layer of `layers` without a blend map or vertex colours (1.5), by
position and `WearBlendBase` (`Material::layer_shares`, the rule the GLB shades by): the
first layer `1 - WearBlendBase`, the others `WearBlendBase` between them, a layer without a
`material` has 0, all shares sum to 1. All 0 means the material keeps its own colours.
Empty when the material has no layers; a package before 1.5 lacks it.

library.description: The material library the material is in, a path below `Data` without extension.

name.description: The material's name in its file; empty when the file gives none.

no_draw.description: Whether the engine draws nothing with the material (flag `0x400` or shader `NoDraw`).

palette.description:
The palette entry the material takes: that of its first layer with a `PaletteTint` from 1
to 3, the glass colour of a glass material that uses the tint palette, or the primary entry
of a stencil decal with `StencilTintOverride`.

parameters.description: The shader parameters (`PublicParams`) in file order, name and value as the file has them.

reads_vertex_colours.description:
Whether the material reads the vertex colours of its mesh (1.4): glass with
`PER_VERTEX_TINT`, and a layered surface without a blend map. The GLB meshes carry
`COLOR_0` on the primitives of such materials only. A package before 1.4 lacks it and reads
as `false` here, which is harmless: this crate only writes it, and the add-on tells an
absent field from `false` itself.

shader.description:
The shader, e.g. `Illum`, `HardSurface`, `Layer`, `MeshDecal` or `GlassPBR`; empty when the
file gives none.

stencil.description:
How a stencil decal (`MeshDecal` with `STENCIL_MAP`) is coloured (1.6), the colour and
opacity of its motif; absent for any other material and in a package before 1.6. The motif
is the texture with the usage `stencil`; a decal without one and without a diffuse map draws
nothing, and one with a diffuse map is drawn by it.

surface_type.description: The physical surface type, e.g. `metal_dense`; empty when the file gives none.

textures.description: The texture slots in file order.

two_sided.description: Whether the engine draws both faces (flag `0x2`).

MaterialLayer.description: One layer of a material: another material blended into the surface.

attributes.description:
All attributes of the layer in file order, the five above included, and `PaletteTint`,
`WearGloss`, `HeightBias`, `HeightScale` and any other.

gloss_mult.description: The factor of the layer's glossiness (`GlossMult`).

material.description:
The id of the material the layer's `Path` names, in `materials`; absent when the layer names
no material, or the file is missing or unreadable (an issue is listed).

name.description: The layer's name (`Name`), e.g. `Primary` or `Wear`; empty when the file gives none.

palette.description: The palette entry the layer takes, from its `PaletteTint`.

path.description:
The layer material's file (`Path`), a path below `Data` with its extension; empty when the
file gives none.

sub_material.description: The sub-material of the layer file (`Submtl`) by name; absent when the layer names none.

tint_colour.description:
The tint colour (`TintColor`), linear, that multiplies the layer's colour; absent when the
file gives none or it is malformed.

uv_tiling.description: The tiling of the layer's UVs (`UVTiling`).

wear_tint.description: The tint colour of the layer where it is worn (`WearTint`), linear.

MaterialStencil.description:
How a stencil decal is coloured (1.6); the stencil map itself is the texture with the usage
`stencil`.

colour.description:
The colour of the motif (`StencilDiffuseColor`), linear; absent when the file gives none or
it is malformed, and the material's `diffuse` counts.

opacity.description:
The opacity of the motif (`StencilOpacity`) from 0 to 1, 1 when the file gives none; it
multiplies the material's `opacity`.

MaterialTexture.description: One texture slot of a material.

attributes.description: The other attributes of the slot in file order.

elements.description: The child elements of the slot, such as `TexMod` with the tiling and offset of the UV set.

file.description:
The texture as the file names it, source image or engine placeholder such as
`$TintPaletteDecal`.

slot.description: The slot as the file names it: `TexSlot1`, `TexSlot2`, and so on.

texture.description:
The id of the texture in `textures`; absent for a placeholder or a texture that could not
be written.

usage.description: What the texture is used for.

MaterialTextures.description:
The texture ids of a material by role; a role is absent when the material names no texture for
it or the texture could not be written.

Mesh.description: One GLB mesh: the geometry of a model drawn with one material library and one palette.

bytes.description: The size of the file in bytes.

file.description: The GLB file relative to the package folder, e.g. `meshes/m0001.glb`.

geometry.description: The geometry file in the Archive the model was read from, below `Data`.

id.description: The mesh's id, e.g. `m0001`; also the stem of its file.

instances.description: The number of nodes that draw this mesh; more than one means the mesh is instanced.

materials.description:
The materials the mesh is drawn with, in the order of the glTF materials in its file; empty
for a mesh with a `rig`, whose materials are in the file.

palette.description: The name of the tint palette the mesh's colours were taken from, when it has one.

palette_id.description: The id of that palette in `palettes`.

rig.description:
The skeleton, skinned parts, morph targets and animations of the file; present for a
Character (version 1.3), absent for a static mesh.

triangles.description: The number of triangles of the mesh.

vertices.description: The number of vertices of the mesh.

MeshMaterial.description: A material of a mesh and the textures its material file names.

index.description: The index of the glTF material in the mesh's file.

material.description:
The id of the material's description in `materials`; absent for the engine's default
material.

name.description: The name of the glTF material in the mesh's file.

textures.description: The textures that were written for the material.

Node.description: One node of the scene hierarchy.

entity.description: The Entity placed at the node; present for the kind `entity`, absent for the others.

light.description: The light at the node; present for the kind `light`.

mesh.description: The id of the mesh drawn at the node; absent when the node draws nothing.

name.description:
The node's name: `<port>/<entity>` or the class name for the root, the name from the
Interior's files for the other kinds.

parent.description: The index of the parent node in `nodes`, absent for the root.

path.description:
The path of the node from the root, the port names or, below `Interior`, the names of the
nodes joined by `/`; empty for the root.

rotation.description: The rotation relative to the parent as a unit quaternion `[x, y, z, w]`.

scale.description: The scale relative to the parent; a negative X marks a mirroring transform.

translation.description: The translation relative to the parent, in metres.

oneOf.description: An Entity of the Archive; `entity` names it.

A group of the Interior: the node that holds the containers of an Entity, a container or a
`.soc` file a container streams. It draws nothing.
A model an Interior places, a prop or a placed model; it draws a mesh.
A light an Interior places; `light` describes it.

A Character: the node draws a mesh whose `rig` holds a skeleton, skinned parts, morph
targets and animations.

Options.description: The choices a package was written with.

exclude.description: The ports left out of the Loadout, as the paths `entity loadout` lists.

lod.description:
The level of detail of every model, 0 for the most detailed; a model that lacks it is
written at the nearest lower level.

replace.description: The Entities attached to a port instead of what it holds.

texture_mip.description:
The mip level of the textures, 0 for the largest; a texture with fewer mips gives its
smallest.

vertex_colours.description: Whether the meshes carry the vertex colours of their models.

Palette.description:
A tint palette: the colours a livery gives the materials that take a palette entry.

A palette is written once; meshes reference it by id.

glass.description: The colour of the tinted glass, linear.

PaletteColours.description: The colours of one palette entry, linear.

PaletteEntry.description: Which colour of a palette a material or layer takes.

oneOf.description: The primary entry (`PaletteTint` 1).
The secondary entry (`PaletteTint` 2).
The tertiary entry (`PaletteTint` 3).
The glass colour.

Parameter.description: A name and a value as the material file gives them.

value.description: The attribute's value, text as in the file.

Replacement.description: An Entity attached to a port instead of what the Loadout puts there.

entity.description: The Entity as the user named it.

Rig.description:
The skeleton, skins, morph targets and animations a mesh file carries.

A mesh with a `rig` is a skinned Character: the GLB holds the bones as nodes, one glTF skin
over them, a skinned mesh per part, the morph targets of the parts and the animations, and a
reader imports it once, not as an instance.

animations.description: The animations in the GLB file, in order.

body.description: The code of the body variant the Character is worn on, e.g. `male`.

bones.description: The number of bones written as nodes.

embedded_textures.description:
The number of PNG images embedded in the GLB file; the textures of a Character are not
written as files of the package.

morph_targets.description: The number of morph targets over all meshes.

parts.description: The skins worn on the skeleton, the body first.

skeleton.description: The skeleton file the bones come from, below `Data`.

skinned_meshes.description: The number of meshes that carry bone weights.

RigClip.description: One animation of a Character as the GLB file holds it.

additive.description: Whether the keys are offsets to be added to a pose, which glTF cannot say.

channels.description: The number of channels: rotation, translation and morph weight tracks.

name.description: The animation's name, also the name of the glTF animation.

RigPart.description: One skin worn on the skeleton of a Character.

file.description: The skin file the part was read from, below `Data`.

morph_targets.description: The number of morph targets of the part's mesh.

name.description: The name of the part's node in the GLB file.

RigPartOrigin.description: Where a part of a Character comes from.

oneOf.description: The skin of the default body.
The skin of a piece: the head, an item of the head or a piece of armour or clothing.

build.description: The Build of the Archive; absent when its manifest could not be read.

channel.description:
The Channel folder name of the Archive, e.g. `LIVE`; absent when the Archive is in no
Channel folder.

character.description: What a Character was made from (1.3); present in a Character package only.

entity.description:
The Entity the scene was built from. A Character package puts the Character's name in
`class_name` and an empty `guid`.

Texture.description: One texture file of the package.

bit_depth.description: The bits per channel; 8 in version 1.

colour_space.description: How the colour channels are encoded.

file.description: The image file relative to the package folder, e.g. `textures/t0001.png`.

height.description: The height in pixels of the mip level that was written.

id.description: The texture's id, e.g. `t0001`; also the stem of its file.

source.description: The texture's path in the Archive, below `Data`.

width.description: The width in pixels of the mip level that was written.

TextureFormat.description: The image format of a texture file.

oneOf.description: An 8-bit RGBA PNG.

TextureUse.description:
What a texture of a material is used for, by the file naming convention of the game's
textures and the slot it sits in.

oneOf.description: The colour map (`_diff`, and any other map in `TexSlot1`).
The normal map (`_ddna` with the smoothness in alpha, or `_ddn`).
The specular map (`_spec`).
A mask or opacity map (`_mask`, `_opac`).
A blend map between layers (`_blend`).
A detail map (`_detail`).
A wear map (`_wear`).
An ambient occlusion map (`_ao`).
A displacement or height map (`_displ`, `_disp`).
A gloss map (`_gloss`).

The stencil map of a stencil decal (`STENCIL_MAP`, 1.6): its red channel is the opacity of
the motif.
Any other map; the slot and file say more.
Metres. A reader refuses a unit it does not know.

description: The scene description of a package: `scene.json`.

coordinates.description: The axes and unit of every transform and of the GLB meshes.

format.description: Always `p4kx-blender-package`; tells a reader that the folder is a package.

generator.description: The program that wrote the package.

issues.description: What could not be resolved or written, with the node or texture it concerns.

materials.description:
The material descriptions of the meshes and of their layers, each written once; absent in
version 1.0.

meshes.description: The GLB meshes, one per distinct mesh set; nodes reference them.

nodes.description: The scene hierarchy; a node comes after its parent.

options.description: The choices the package was written with.

palettes.description: The tint palettes of the meshes, each written once; absent in version 1.0.

textures.description: The PNG textures, each written once.

version.description:
The version of the package format, `<major>.<minor>`, see [`FORMAT_VERSION`]. A reader
refuses a higher major version and warns about a higher minor one.
